test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 5 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Amar Jeet Singh can complete a piece of work in 5 days. With the help of his son he can complete it in 3 days. In how many days can the son independently complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by Amar Jeet Singh to do the work = 5 days 

Time taken by Amar Jeet Singh and his son to do the work = 3 days 

**Formula used:**

Total work = Efficiency × Time 

**Calculation:**

By LCM Method

Let the total work be the LCM of 5 and 3 as being the common multiple. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a8f823c3f7245603d54ed58295f4b14b853c8f0c0ddc17d89259aaa16502158.png] 

Efficiency of the son = 5 - 3 = 2 units per day
